lead_raw_text:
The structure of SrInRu crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P-62m (No. 189), with a unit cell containing six atoms—two Sr, two In, and two Ru—distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Sr centers with 12 geometric neighbors (six In and six Ru), while In and Ru each have 9 neighbors. These environments form a single three-dimensional connected component. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis reveals corner, edge, and face sharing among Sr 12-vertex polyhedra, and edge sharing between In and Ru 9-vertex polyhedra.
